warning: TEST-ONLY KEYS. Every private key in this file is public. Never use them outside tests.
regeneration: Generated by the API gateway's own vector generator, which is not public. Keys and Ed25519 signatures are deterministic. P-256 signatures are randomised: one already in the file is kept while it still verifies, a new one is fresh, so compare verdicts and never expect a P-256 signature to be reproduced.

wire.signedString:
"vaultody-request-keypair-v1
" apiKey "
" timestamp "
" method "
" path "
" apiVersion "
" passphrase "
" nonce "
" query "
" body, as UTF-8, no trailing newline. The HMAC v2 fields in the same order, under another tag and after the API key.
wire.fields: apiKey = x-api-key, the API key the request is sent with (two API keys may hold the same public key, so a request signed for one is refused under the other); timestamp = x-api-timestamp; method as sent; path as sent, without the query (with the /v2 prefix if the client called through it); apiVersion = x-api-version, empty if not sent; passphrase = x-api-passphrase; nonce = x-api-nonce (required with a key-pair signature: 1-128 printable ASCII 0x21-0x7E); query = the raw query string after "?", empty if none; body = the raw body as sent, empty if none.
wire.signature: Ed25519: the raw 64-byte signature. ECDSA P-256: SHA-256, DER encoded (IEEE P1363 r||s is refused). Standard base64 with padding, in the one spelling an encoder writes.
wire.fingerprint: "SHA256:" + base64 without padding of SHA-256 over the canonical SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER of the public key (a P-256 point uncompressed, 65 bytes); 50 characters
wire.publicKey: one PEM "PUBLIC KEY" block (SubjectPublicKeyInfo), Ed25519 or P-256 only
wire.headers: x-api-sign-version: 2 (the HMAC v2 x-api-sign is still sent), x-api-nonce, x-api-keypair-sign = base64(signature over the signed string), x-api-keypair-id = the fingerprint of the key that signed

order: x-api-keypair-id equals the fingerprint of a key registered on the API key, else unknown_api_keypair_id.
x-api-keypair-sign is canonical base64, else invalid_api_keypair_sign.
The signature verifies with that key over the signed string rebuilt from verify.request (Ed25519: exactly 64 bytes; P-256: DER), else invalid_api_keypair_sign.

reasons.unknown_api_keypair_id: x-api-keypair-id is not the fingerprint of a key registered on the API key
reasons.invalid_api_keypair_sign: the signature is malformed or does not verify over this request with that key

caseFormat.signed: what the client signed: the key name (keys), its algorithm, the request fields (apiKey = x-api-key), the exact signed string (also as base64 of its UTF-8 bytes) and the signature
caseFormat.verify: what the gateway checks: the request as received (apiKey = the x-api-key it arrived with), the two key-pair headers as received, and the names of the keys registered on that API key
caseFormat.expected: { valid: true } or { valid: false, reason }
caseFormat.publicKeys: a public key as pasted, and either { algorithm, canonicalSpkiDerBase64, fingerprint } or { error } with the API's error code

publicKeys.name: p256_uncompressed
publicKeys.description: A P-256 public key with an uncompressed point, as openssl and the CLI write it.

publicKeys.name: p256_compressed
publicKeys.description: The same P-256 key with its point compressed (33 bytes): it is made uncompressed before hashing, so the fingerprint is the same. Hashing the DER as pasted would give another one.

publicKeys.name: secp256k1
publicKeys.description: A secp256k1 public key (the Bitcoin and Ethereum curve).

publicKeys.name: ed25519_private_key
publicKeys.description: A private key pasted by mistake (PKCS#8 PEM): refused before it is parsed, and never logged.
